# ML-KEM known-answer fixtures

Full-byte vectors embedded in `tests/mlkem_acvp_vectors.mojo` are copied from the public NIST ACVP Server repository at revision `975de31eb83d87039ec88934fdc47d8c312b892d`:

- https://github.com/usnistgov/ACVP-Server/blob/975de31eb83d87039ec88934fdc47d8c312b892d/gen-val/json-files/ML-KEM-keyGen-FIPS203/internalProjection.json
- https://github.com/usnistgov/ACVP-Server/blob/975de31eb83d87039ec88934fdc47d8c312b892d/gen-val/json-files/ML-KEM-encapDecap-FIPS203/internalProjection.json

`selection.json` records the source file SHA-256 hashes, group IDs and case IDs. The tests compare complete keys, ciphertexts and shared secrets, not prefixes. Decapsulation includes every case in the selected 512/768 groups, including modified ciphertexts and their expected implicit-rejection outputs. The expected outputs were not generated by mcrypto.

The complete upstream notice is preserved in `NOTICE.txt`.

Source: NIST public test data; the upstream repository's [license notice](https://github.com/usnistgov/ACVP-Server/blob/975de31eb83d87039ec88934fdc47d8c312b892d/README.md#license) applies to these fixtures. These are public test keys, never production keys. Passing these tests is not NIST certification.
